authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationExpectation.beforeCount_le

theorem beforeCount_le [Finite I] [Preorder P]

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationExpectation.beforeEvent_eq_minimumEvent
authored_declarations.header_text:
private theorem beforeEvent_eq_minimumEvent [LinearOrder P] [DecidableEq I]
    (priority : I → P) (hinj : Function.Injective priority)
    (S : Finset I) (b : I) (hb : b ∉ S) :
    {π : Equiv.Perm I | ∀ a ∈ S, priority (π b) < priority (π a)} =
      minimumEvent priority (insert b S) b

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationExpectation.cast_beforeCount_eq_sum
authored_declarations.header_text:
private theorem cast_beforeCount_eq_sum [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Preorder P]
    (priority : I → P) (S : Finset I) (π : Equiv.Perm I) :
    (beforeCount priority S π : ℝ≥0∞) =
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ \ S,
        ({ρ : Equiv.Perm I | ∀ a ∈ S, priority (ρ b) < priority (ρ a)}).indicator
          (1 : Equiv.Perm I → ℝ≥0∞) π

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationExpectation.lintegral_beforeCount_uniformOn
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem lintegral_beforeCount_uniformOn [Finite I] [LinearOrder P]
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (priority : I → P) (hinj : Function.Injective priority) (S : Finset I) :
    (∫⁻ π, (beforeCount priority S π : ℝ≥0∞)
        ∂uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I))) =
      ((Nat.card I - S.card : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) / ((S.card + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)

theorem integral_beforeCount_uniformOn [Finite I] [LinearOrder P]

    (∫ π, (beforeCount priority S π : ℝ)
        ∂uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I))) =
      ((Nat.card I - S.card : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((S.card + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationExpectation.beforeCount_rank_eq
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem beforeCount_rank_eq {U : ℕ} (rank : I ≃ Fin U)
    (S : Finset I) (hS : S.Nonempty) (π : Equiv.Perm I) :
    beforeCount rank S π =
      ((S.image (fun a => rank (π a))).min'
        (hS.image (fun a => rank (π a)))).val

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationExpectation.integral_firstPosition_uniformOn
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem integral_firstPosition_uniformOn {U : ℕ}
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (rank : I ≃ Fin U) (S : Finset I) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    (∫ π,
        ((((S.image (fun a => rank (π a))).min'
          (hS.image (fun a => rank (π a)))).val + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
        ∂uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I))) =
      ((U + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((S.card + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.fiber_mass_eq
authored_declarations.header_text:
private theorem fiber_mass_eq
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions)
    (S : Finset I) (xs ys : List I)
    (hxs : xs ∈ orders positions S) (hys : ys ∈ orders positions S) :
    uniformOn Set.univ {π | restrictedOrder positions S π = xs} =
      uniformOn Set.univ {π | restrictedOrder positions S π = ys}

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.uniformOn_restrictedOrder_eq
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem uniformOn_restrictedOrder_eq
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions)
    (S : Finset I) (xs : List I) :
    uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I))
        {π | restrictedOrder positions S π = xs} =
      if xs ∈ orders positions S
      then (Nat.factorial S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹
      else 0

    (S : Finset I) :
    (uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I))).map (restrictedOrder positions S) =
      uniformOn (orders positions S : Set (List I))

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.exists_relabel_order_pair
authored_declarations.header_text:
private theorem exists_relabel_order_pair (positions : List I)
    (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions)
    (A B : Finset I) (hAB : Disjoint A B)
    (xs ys xs' ys' : List I)
    (hxs : xs ∈ orders positions A) (hys : ys ∈ orders positions B)
    (hxs' : xs' ∈ orders positions A) (hys' : ys' ∈ orders positions B) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm I,
      xs.map σ = xs' ∧ ys.map σ = ys' ∧
        (∀ a, σ a ∈ A ↔ a ∈ A) ∧ (∀ a, σ a ∈ B ↔ a ∈ B)

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.pair_fiber_mass_eq
authored_declarations.header_text:
private theorem pair_fiber_mass_eq
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions)
    (A B : Finset I) (hAB : Disjoint A B) (p q : List I × List I)
    (hp : p ∈ (orders positions A).product (orders positions B))
    (hq : q ∈ (orders positions A).product (orders positions B)) :
    uniformOn Set.univ
        {π | (restrictedOrder positions A π, restrictedOrder positions B π) = p} =
      uniformOn Set.univ
        {π | (restrictedOrder positions A π, restrictedOrder positions B π) = q}

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.uniformOn_restrictedOrder_pair_eq
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem uniformOn_restrictedOrder_pair_eq
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions)
    (A B : Finset I) (hAB : Disjoint A B) (xs ys : List I) :
    uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I))
        {π | (restrictedOrder positions A π, restrictedOrder positions B π) = (xs, ys)} =
      if xs ∈ orders positions A ∧ ys ∈ orders positions B then
        ((Nat.factorial A.card * Nat.factorial B.card : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹
      else 0

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.map_restrictedOrder_pair_uniformOn
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem map_restrictedOrder_pair_uniformOn
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    [MeasurableSpace (List I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (List I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions)
    (A B : Finset I) (hAB : Disjoint A B) :
    (uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I))).map
        (fun π => (restrictedOrder positions A π, restrictedOrder positions B π)) =
      (uniformOn (orders positions A : Set (List I))).prod
        (uniformOn (orders positions B : Set (List I)))

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.filter_pair_hasLaw_orders
authored_declarations.header_text:
private theorem filter_pair_hasLaw_orders
    [MeasurableSpace (List I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (List I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions)
    (S A B : Finset I) (hAS : A ⊆ S) (hBS : B ⊆ S) (hAB : Disjoint A B) :
    HasLaw
      (fun xs : List I => (xs.filter (fun a => decide (a ∈ A)),
        xs.filter (fun b => decide (b ∈ B))))
      ((uniformOn (orders positions A : Set (List I))).prod
        (uniformOn (orders positions B : Set (List I))))
      (uniformOn (orders positions S : Set (List I)))

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.hasLaw_filter_pair
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem hasLaw_filter_pair {Ω : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace (List I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (List I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions)
    (S : Finset I) {μ : Measure Ω} {Y : Ω → List I}
    (hY : HasLaw Y (uniformOn (orders positions S : Set (List I))) μ)
    (A B : Finset I) (hAS : A ⊆ S) (hBS : B ⊆ S) (hAB : Disjoint A B) :
    HasLaw
      (fun ω => ((Y ω).filter (fun a => decide (a ∈ A)),
        (Y ω).filter (fun b => decide (b ∈ B))))
      ((uniformOn (orders positions A : Set (List I))).prod
        (uniformOn (orders positions B : Set (List I)))) μ

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.inter_fiber_mass_eq
authored_declarations.header_text:
private theorem inter_fiber_mass_eq
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions)
    (A : Finset I) (E : Set (Equiv.Perm I))
    (hInvariant : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm I),
      (∀ a, σ a ∈ A ↔ a ∈ A) →
      ∀ π, (π * σ.symm ∈ E ↔ π ∈ E))
    (xs ys : List I) (hxs : xs ∈ orders positions A) (hys : ys ∈ orders positions A) :
    uniformOn Set.univ (E ∩ {π | restrictedOrder positions A π = xs}) =
      uniformOn Set.univ (E ∩ {π | restrictedOrder positions A π = ys})

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.uniformOn_inter_restrictedOrder_eq
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem uniformOn_inter_restrictedOrder_eq
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions)
    (A : Finset I) (E : Set (Equiv.Perm I))
    (hInvariant : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm I),
      (∀ a, σ a ∈ A ↔ a ∈ A) →
      ∀ π, (π * σ.symm ∈ E ↔ π ∈ E))
    (xs : List I) :
    uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I))
        (E ∩ {π | restrictedOrder positions A π = xs}) =
      if xs ∈ orders positions A
      then uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I)) E /
        (Nat.factorial A.card : ℝ≥0∞)
      else 0

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationPlacement.lintegral_beforeCount_mul_order
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem lintegral_beforeCount_mul_order [LinearOrder P]
    {Ω : Type w} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions)
    (priority : I → P) (hinj : Function.Injective priority) (A : Finset I)
    (g : List I → ℝ≥0∞) {μ : Measure Ω} {Π : Ω → Equiv.Perm I}
    (hΠ : HasLaw Π (uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I))) μ) :
    (∫⁻ ω, (beforeCount priority A (Π ω) : ℝ≥0∞) *
        g (restrictedOrder positions A (Π ω)) ∂μ) =
      (((Nat.card I - A.card : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) / ((A.card + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)) *
        ∫⁻ ω, g (restrictedOrder positions A (Π ω)) ∂μ

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationPlacement.real_weighted_moment
authored_declarations.header_text:
private theorem real_weighted_moment [LinearOrder P]
    {Ω : Type w} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions)
    (priority : I → P) (hinj : Function.Injective priority) (A : Finset I)
    (g : List I → ℝ) {μ : Measure Ω} {Π : Ω → Equiv.Perm I}
    (hΠ : HasLaw Π (uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I))) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (beforeCount priority A (Π ω) : ℝ)) μ ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => g (restrictedOrder positions A (Π ω))) μ ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => (beforeCount priority A (Π ω) : ℝ) *
        g (restrictedOrder positions A (Π ω))) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (beforeCount priority A (Π ω) : ℝ) *
          g (restrictedOrder positions A (Π ω)) ∂μ) =
        (((Nat.card I - A.card : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((A.card + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
          ∫ ω, g (restrictedOrder positions A (Π ω)) ∂μ

authored_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationPlacement.integral_beforeCount_mul_order
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem integral_beforeCount_mul_order [LinearOrder P]
    {Ω : Type w} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions)

authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem retained_global_head_boundary :
    HasLaw PermutationExpectationBoundary.singletonOrder
      (uniformOn (orders PermutationExpectationBoundary.positions
        PermutationExpectationBoundary.singleton : Set (List (Fin 3))))
      PermutationExpectationBoundary.original ∧
    HasLaw PermutationExpectationBoundary.singletonOrder
      (uniformOn (orders PermutationExpectationBoundary.positions
        PermutationExpectationBoundary.singleton : Set (List (Fin 3))))
      PermutationExpectationBoundary.afterZero ∧
    (∫ π, (beforeCount rank3 PermutationExpectationBoundary.singleton π : ℝ)
      ∂PermutationExpectationBoundary.afterZero) ≠
      ∫ π, (beforeCount rank3 PermutationExpectationBoundary.singleton π : ℝ)
        ∂PermutationExpectationBoundary.original

authored_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationPlacementBoundary.retained_adaptive_boundary
authored_declarations.header_text:

      beforeCount rank3 (PermutationExpectationBoundary.adaptiveSubset π) π = 0) ∧
    (∫ π, (beforeCount rank3 (PermutationExpectationBoundary.adaptiveSubset π) π : ℝ)
      ∂law3) ≠
      ∫ π, (beforeCount rank3 PermutationExpectationBoundary.singleton π : ℝ)
        ∂law3

authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem preserving_can_move_outsider :
    (∀ a : Fin 4, Equiv.swap 2 3 a ∈ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 4)) ↔
      a ∈ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 4))) ∧ Equiv.swap (2 : Fin 4) 3 2 ≠ 2

authored_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationPlacementBoundary.outsider_swap_count_preserved
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem outsider_swap_count_preserved (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) :
    beforeCount (fun a : Fin 4 => a) ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 4))
        (π * (Equiv.swap 2 3).symm) =
      beforeCount (fun a : Fin 4 => a) ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 4)) π
